results.title: Memories Move Like Distant Islands
results.overview: A wetland archaeologist tracks groundwater levels in a drained swamp. In a quiet village, the emergency call center receives reports of a drifting island. This kaleidoscopic tale takes us on a journey across time and place, exploring the tense relationship between humans and wetlands from surprising perspectives that blend science and oral folklore.

results.title: Goodbye, Farewell
results.overview: Wyn arrives in Seoul searching for her missing boyfriend, Dani, and meets Rey, an Indonesian worker who helps her. As they grow close, Rey uncovers Dani's secret new identity but keeps it hidden. When Wyn reunites with Dani, she disappears soon after, leaving Rey to embark on a desperate search to find her.

results.title: Strike: Silat Cult Master
results.overview: Izra fled his home after gang leader Abil murdered his mother Salmah, taking only a mysterious pendant that she had given him. Tok Rahmat rescued the young boy and became his martial arts mentor. Years later, seeking vengeance for his mother`s death, Izra tracked down Abil. Along the way, he formed an alliance with other skilled martial artists who joined his quest for justice.

results.title: Paradise
results.overview: A young man visits a Buddhist temple in the hopes of quenching his thirst.

results.title: Fish Gone
results.overview: Jackie Gold, a lonely private investigator, only has one friend in this world: his pet fish named Frilliam. When Frilliam mysteriously goes missing, Jackie must find him... before it's too late.

results.title: Fine Lady
results.overview: Amalia arrives at Olga’s house to celebrate her birthday. At the party, they discuss taboo subjects: one’s daughter is dating a bisexual boy, while the other’s granddaughter sells erotic content online. Uncomfortable, Amalia seizes an opportunity to leave. Back home, she reveals her best kept secret.

results.title: The Great Christmas Snow-In
results.overview: After his engagement is called off, Justin retreats to a secluded cabin meant for his honeymoon, only to be snowed in with Jane, his ex-fiancée’s cousin. As tension builds, a spark forms between them, but when Justin’s ex shows up with her new boyfriend, things get even more complicated. In the close quarters of the cabin, secrets unravel, leading to unexpected discoveries about love and second chances.

results.title: Patakha
results.overview: Radha, an 11-year-old girl in rural India, loses her backpack on her first day of work at a factory. She journeys to retrieve the school bag and with it, her dreams for the future.

results.title: The Mail Lady 2
results.overview: After shooting Renee and disappearing without a trace, Sloan builds a new life under a stolen name. But when she learns she’s pregnant with Derek’s child, her obsession reignites, twisting into a desperate dream of reunion, redemption, and revenge. Derek must become a changed man if he is to protect everything he loves and take down Sloan once and for all.

results.title: Operation Friendship
results.overview: A young boy and his friends are bullied by a kid who takes the toy army of anyone that challenges him, amassing a virtually undefeatable force. With the help of his grandfather who served in World War II, his loyal friends, and his love of history, he'll take the battle to the bully and learn the importance of teamwork, family, and friendship to claim victory.

results.title: Narrative
results.overview: In 2010, more than 90 civilians were killed and 2,000 injured during crackdowns on pro-democracy protests in Bangkok; to date, Thai authorities have not held any government or military officials accountable. The film reframes the experiences of survivors by filming them sharing their stories in facilitated workshops and discussing how to seek justice for their family members with a human rights lawyer.

results.title: Les amours électriques
results.overview: AVA is the Artificial Intelligence that manages a dating app. Everywhere she watches men and women, their eyes glued to their cell phones. She hears their voices. Among these people, Anna is looking for love. She has no secrets for AVA. But at what cost? AVA is watching you.

results.title: Gangstas
results.overview: On the streets of Antwerp, Badia, Junes and Volt are trying to tear themselves away from their past, but the underworld is inexorably pulling them back in. Adamo has worked his way up to become one of the most influential figures in the Antwerp drug trade. He becomes ever more entangled in a web of power and danger. His friends have to make a choice: stay loyal to Adamo or choose safety.

results.title: Torment
results.overview: An exhausted security guard is transferred to a morgue and, on their first night, discovers that the shadows and silences hide a torment from which there may be no return.

results.title: The Royal We
results.overview: When her older sister elopes with a non-royal, Princess Bea who has lived her life away from her royal duties must now step in and honor the arranged marriage to a small kingdom prince.

results.title: The Landscape of Human Essence
results.overview: Despite their hardships, Ljubica and the few remaining other village residents find peace, connection and freedom in a remote Macedonian village.

results.title: Purple
results.overview: Two strangers meet on a layover in Los Angeles. Over 24 hours they discover more about the city, and each other, than most people do in a lifetime.

results.title: Mother's Baby
results.overview: A woman navigates the complex journey of motherhood while confronting her deepest fears and anxieties.

results.title: The Manggis in Ah Gong's Hands
results.overview: A bigoted Chinese grandfather having to look after his biracial grandson at the onset of a global pandemic lockdown
